episodes.title: New Days
episodes.synopsis: Tempest is thriving after the success of its festival, but unexpected trouble has arisen with the new dungeon.

episodes.title: The Dungeon Evolves
episodes.synopsis: Rimuru and his trusted companions discuss ideas for improving the dungeon.

episodes.title: The Avatar Team Is Formed
episodes.synopsis: Rimuru, Ramiris, Veldora, and Milim work on perfecting their avatars before facing Team Green Fury.

episodes.title: Invitation
episodes.synopsis: The Council of the West deliberates on whether to grant membership to Tempest.

episodes.title: The First Step
episodes.synopsis: Rimuru attends the meeting that will determine Tempest's membership in the Council of the West.

episodes.title: The Council of the West
episodes.synopsis: A list of unreasonable demands from the Council makes Rimuru realize that a deeper plot is in motion.

episodes.title: The Mastermind`s Identity
episodes.synopsis: An interrogation of Prince Elric's would-be shooter reveals who's pulling the strings behind the Council.

episodes.title: The Groundwork of Greed
episodes.synopsis: Glenda reveals all she knows about the Council and the Rozzos, and Rimuru prepares to inspect ancient ruins.

episodes.title: Investigating the Ruins
episodes.synopsis: The investigation of the ancient ruins of Amrita begins.

episodes.title: The Master of Greed
episodes.synopsis: Rimuru and Mirabel come face-to-face at last in the ancient ruins.

episodes.title: Milim`s Friend
episodes.synopsis: Rimuru helps Milim confront the Chaos Dragon, a corrupted form of the baby dragon that was once her friend.

episodes.title: Tempest Evolves
episodes.synopsis: Rimuru shares his plans for Tempest's future, including a new system of government and Council representation.

episodes.title: New Companions
episodes.synopsis: Ramiris and Veldora are feeling overworked, so they ask Rimuru to find assistants for them.

episodes.title: The Black Numbers
episodes.synopsis: Diablo returns with new demon subordinates to add to Tempest's ranks.

episodes.title: An Unsettling Feeling
episodes.synopsis: As Tempest continues to grow and evolve, the Moderate Harlequin Alliance approaches Demon Lord Leon.

episodes.title: Gran, the Hero of Dawn
episodes.synopsis: Luminus meets with Rimuru to discuss Gran and future plans.

episodes.title: Lubelius, the Point of Convergence
episodes.synopsis: While Leon seeks Elmesia's help in finding Chloe, Granville's forces invade Lubelius.

episodes.title: Turbulence in the West
episodes.synopsis: An army of demons advances from the north, leaving the Western Nations in turmoil.

episodes.title: Death and Loss
episodes.synopsis: Granville's true plan is revealed, but it may already be too late to stop it.

episodes.title: Chronoa the Hero, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: When Chloe's Time Traveler skill kicks in, Hinata's soul is sent to the past along with her.

episodes.title: Chronoa the Hero, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Chloe and Hinata meet Luminus and begin their journey as Chronoa.

episodes.title: Where the Soul Resides
episodes.synopsis: Chronoa is freed from her seal—not as a Hero, but as an avatar of destruction.

episodes.title: Granville`s Hope
episodes.synopsis: Shion and Ranga continue to battle Razul while Rimuru struggles to save Chloe and Hinata.

episodes.title: The Hero Awakens
episodes.synopsis: Rimuru has Raphael interfere in Chronoa's Unlimited Imprisonment skill to save Hinata and Chloe.

related.title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken
related.plot: Un uomo di 37 anni, disoccupato e senza una fidanzata, dopo essere stato ucciso da un rapinatore in fuga, si ritrova in un nuovo mondo, reincarnato in uno slime cieco, ma con abilità uniche. Con il nuovo nome di “Rimuru Tempest” inizia così la sua nuova vita in un altro mondo con un sempre più crescente numero di seguaci.

related.plot: La storia si svolgerà in una nuova nazione, Razha, situata a Ovest di Tempest. Rimuru e i suoi compagni verranno coinvolti in una cospirazione di lunga data che ruota attorno a una ragazza con dei misteriosi poteri. Benimaru incontrerà un altro orco sopravvissuto, Hiiro, che sembra avere grande stima per il comandante di Rimuru.
